title: Homecoming and Yearbook
author: Lena Ravensworth
blurb: Jonah Yarrow, the team's statistician who knows the game is rigged, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must expose what the school board buried, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
